figures.title: Per-class MCC across the eight attack classes
figures.note: One-vs-rest MCC at 25/50/75/100% penetration. Solid bars are vehicle detection windows; dotted bars are controller cycles, where CC-DIM and CC-SI are scored on their blockchain signals. CC-TA and CC-EA have only the LLM channel, which is identically zero here, so their MCC is undefined rather than filled in.
figures.alt: Per-class MCC across the eight attack classes

figures.title: Data-plane per-class MCC vs penetration
figures.note: Each class measured twice: in its own episode, and inside the concurrent all-four episode. TA degrades sharply under concurrency; SI improves.

figures.title: The four per-attack impact metrics
figures.note: IFREA, LIETA, FIIRSI, MFRDIM. FIIRSI is 0.000 at every penetration -- no fake identity is ever accepted once blockchain registration is on. IFREA is a per-flow interception multiplicity, not a ratio, so it exceeds 1.0 legitimately.

figures.title: Controller-compromise payoff, not detection
figures.note: What the CC classes actually measure: NER, DER, RFR, PFER. Every curve is flat from 75% to 100% -- compromise saturates below full penetration.
